obtaining.text: Grows wild on the Lothlórien forest floor, often in patches. Use bone meal on one to spread more onto nearby ground; bone meal on grass inside Lothlórien can also grow woodland flowers. Gardeners sell it, and Great Mallorn flet chests and root-shrine chests can hold it.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Athelas and a Glass Bottle.
Use an empty glass bottle on a Firefly to catch it. You need room in your inventory for the filled bottle.
Buy it from a Woodwright for 32 emeralds once you are a Friend (Harmony +{{lothlorien:rule/friend-harmony}}) with Elf-friend Renown.
Antlers lie on the Lothlórien forest floor; break one by hand to pick it up. An adult Deer buck killed by a player can drop one, a White Deer always drops one, and Lamplighters sell them.

Use an empty glass bottle on Mallorn Leaf Litter or Mallorn Blossom that shows dew in the early morning. The first drop turns the bottle into a Dew Bottle; {{lothlorien:rule/dew-drops}} drops fill it.

Grows wild on the Lothlórien forest floor, often in patches. Use bone meal on one to spread more onto nearby ground; bone meal on grass inside Lothlórien can also grow woodland flowers. Gardeners sell it, and flower-garden supply barrels can hold it.
Craft it at a crafting table from 4 Elven Lanterns and a Deer Antler.
Buy it from a Gardener for 32 emeralds once you are a Friend (Harmony +{{lothlorien:rule/friend-harmony}}) with Elf-friend Renown.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Mallorn Trapdoors and a Bottle of Fireflies, or buy it from a Lamplighter.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Golden Mallorn Trapdoors and a Bottle of Fireflies, or buy it from a Lamplighter.

Craft it at a crafting table from a Bottle of Morning Dew and a Golden Fern; you get the glass bottle back. Woodwrights sell it, and Great Mallorn flet chests can hold it. The recipe unlocks when you fill your first Bottle of Morning Dew.
Craft it at a crafting table from a Mallorn Button and a Bottle of Fireflies.
Buy a bundle from a Woodwright once you have Trusted Renown, or find them in Great Mallorn flet chests.
The most common plant on the Lothlórien forest floor. Break it by hand or with any tool to collect it, or use bone meal on one to spread more nearby. Gardeners sell it too.

A White Deer's gift. As a Friend (Harmony +{{lothlorien:rule/friend-harmony}}), offer a Mallorn Acorn to a White Deer inside Lothlórien that is not on a lead, then follow it; when you arrive it lays the nut at its feet. Each White Deer gives one nut in its lifetime.
Bake Lembas Dough in a furnace or smoker.
Craft 2 at a crafting table from 3 Western Corn Grain and 1 Sugar.
Wrap a Lembas Cake in Mallorn Leaves at a crafting table. Great Mallorn flet chests and root-shrine chests can also hold Lembas.

Break Mallorn Leaves without shears or Silk Touch: each leaf block has a small chance to drop an acorn (2%, up to 4% with Fortune III). Gardeners sell acorns, flower-garden supply barrels always hold some, and Great Mallorn flet chests can.
Lies on the forest floor under Mallorn trees; breaking a patch gives back all its pieces (1 to 4). Ground Squirrels can bring it as a gift, and Gardeners sell it.
Craft it at a crafting table from 5 Mallorn Planks.
Craft it at a crafting table from 1 Mallorn Planks.
Craft it at a crafting table from a Mallorn Boat and a Chest.
Craft 3 at a crafting table from 6 Mallorn Planks.
Craft 3 at a crafting table from 4 Mallorn Planks and 2 Sticks.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Mallorn Planks and 4 Sticks.
Craft it at a crafting table from a Mallorn Leaf Litter and a Stick. Break it with any tool or by hand to pick it up again.
Craft it at a crafting table from 5 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft it at a crafting table from 1 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft it at a crafting table from a Golden Mallorn Boat and a Chest.
Craft 3 at a crafting table from 6 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft 3 at a crafting table from 4 Golden Mallorn Planks and 2 Sticks.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Golden Mallorn Planks and 4 Sticks.
Strip a Mallorn Log or Mallorn Wood with an axe, then craft 4 Golden Mallorn Planks from 1 Stripped Mallorn Log or 1 Stripped Mallorn Wood at a crafting table.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft 6 at a crafting table from 3 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft 4 at a crafting table from 6 Golden Mallorn Planks.
Craft 2 at a crafting table from 6 Golden Mallorn Planks.

Lies on the forest floor under Mallorn trees; breaking a patch gives back all its pieces (1 to 4). You can also craft it from Golden Mallorn Leaves, smelt Mallorn Leaves or Golden Mallorn Leaves in a furnace, or get it as a Ground Squirrel gift.

Grows on Mallorn trees in Lothlórien and on trees you grow from Mallorn Acorns. Collect the leaf block with shears or a Silk Touch tool; broken any other way, it can drop sticks or Mallorn Acorns instead.
Cut it from Mallorn trees in Lothlórien, or grow your own trees from Mallorn Acorns. Woodwrights also sell logs.

Use an empty glass bottle on a full Nectar Bloom, one that has refilled through all {{lothlorien:rule/nectar-stage}} stages. The bloom empties and starts refilling. Great Mallorn flet chests can also hold nectar.
Craft 4 at a crafting table from 1 Mallorn Log or 1 Mallorn Wood.
Craft it at a crafting table from 2 Mallorn Planks.
Craft 6 at a crafting table from 3 Mallorn Planks.
Craft 4 at a crafting table from 6 Mallorn Planks.
Use an axe on a Mallorn Log.
Use an axe on Mallorn Wood, or craft 3 at a crafting table from 4 Stripped Mallorn Logs.
Craft 2 at a crafting table from 6 Mallorn Planks.
Craft 3 at a crafting table from 4 Mallorn Logs.

Craft it at a crafting table from an Empty Miruvor Skin, 3 Athelas Salves, 2 Elanor, 2 Niphredil and 1 Mallorn Nectar; you get the 4 glass bottles back. Healers sell it once you have Elf-friend Renown, and Great Mallorn flet chests and root-shrine chests can hold it.

Fill a Dew Bottle with {{lothlorien:rule/dew-drops}} drops of dew from Mallorn Leaf Litter or Mallorn Blossom under Mallorn Leaves. Dew forms only early in the morning (time {{lothlorien:rule/dew-start}} until before {{lothlorien:rule/dew-end}}). Lamplighters also sell it, and the decorated pot at a root shrine holds one.
Hangs under the leaves of Mallorn trees. Collect it with shears or a Silk Touch tool; broken any other way, it drops nothing. Gardeners sell it once you have Trusted Renown.

Grows wild on the Lothlórien forest floor, often in patches. Use bone meal on one to spread more onto nearby ground; bone meal on grass inside Lothlórien can also grow woodland flowers. Gardeners sell it, and flower-garden supply barrels can hold it.
Buy it from a Lamplighter for 32 emeralds once you are a Friend (Harmony +{{lothlorien:rule/friend-harmony}}) with Elf-friend Renown.
Buy it from a Healer for 32 emeralds once you are a Friend (Harmony +{{lothlorien:rule/friend-harmony}}) with Elf-friend Renown.
Craft 9 at a crafting table from 3 Mallorn Leaves, 3 Bottles of Morning Dew and 3 Deepslate Tiles; you get the 3 glass bottles back. The recipe unlocks when you fill your first Bottle of Morning Dew.
Cook Raw Swan Meat in a furnace, smoker or campfire, or kill an adult Swan while it is on fire.
Adult Swans drop it.
Cook Raw Venison in a furnace, smoker or campfire, or kill an adult Deer or a White Deer while it is on fire.
Adult Deer and White Deer drop it.
Harvest fully grown Western Corn; each mature plant gives 1 grain. Young plants give only seeds.

Break wild Western Corn on the Lothlórien forest floor, or harvest corn you planted: young plants give 1 seed, mature plants up to 3 (more with Fortune, but sometimes none). Gardeners sell seeds, and Ground Squirrels can bring them.

Encounter in the Lothlórien forest.
Your actions towards the forest and its inhabitants change how they respond to you.
Complete Loremaster lessons and requests to improve your Renown. It is separate from Harmony.
Visit a Loremaster to receive lessons and profession requests. Complete the requested handover to earn progress.
Trade with gardeners, healers, woodwrights and lamplighters. Harmony changes prices and access; Renown unlocks stock.
Plant Mallorn Acorns for trees, grow Western Corn on farmland, and collect dew and nectar for supplies.
Dew forms on Mallorn Leaf Litter and Mallorn Blossom in the early morning under Mallorn leaves; collect it with a glass bottle.
Nectar Blooms refill slowly under Mallorn leaves; collect a full bloom with a glass bottle.
Find the shrine beneath a Great Mallorn. Its west-root chest and decorated pot supply treasure and provisions.
Find woodland flowers, a supply barrel and a place to gather plants.
Explore a forest memorial and its surroundings.
Explore naturally generated Great Mallorns and their furnished flet platforms.
Craft from leather, or recover the container after the last sip of Miruvor.
